proposals.title: Implement nominal types and scale constants in packages/core
proposals.why_now: Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, and Tick are branded types with fixed scales and representation rules explicitly specified in ADR-003 (TRAVADO). No DEFINIR is open that affects their definition. Without them all other stub packages remain unimplementable: domain cannot define ledger entries, contracts cannot define DTOs, and world cannot type its price output. They are the shallowest dependency with the widest fan-out.

Determinism test: identical arguments always produce identical output
Sensitivity test: changing masterSeed, namespace, or any single coordinate changes the output
Namespace isolation test: rand with namespace 'market.trend' and 'market.factor' at identical coordinates produce statistically independent series over 10_000 samples
No Math.random, Date, performance, or platform crypto used; lint passes

proposals.title: Write ADR-002 and implement deterministic positional RNG in packages/core
proposals.why_now: The positional RNG rand(masterSeed, namespace, ...coordinates) is required by every layer of the world price generator, macro events, NPC tips, and bot behavior. It is the deepest dependency in the FASE-1 world delivery chain. The hash function is an open DEFINIR (ADR-002); the spec prohibits using the native language hash and recommends SplitMix64 over FNV-1a as a starting point. Nothing in world can proceed until ADR-002 is filed and rand() is implemented.

acceptance_targets: ADR-004 filed in docs/decisions/ documenting modes TRUNCATE_TOWARD_ZERO, ROUND_HALF_UP, and ROUND_HALF_EVEN, plus the chosen technical enforcement mechanism (lint rule, type-level marker, or required parameter)
divTruncate(dividend: bigint, divisor: bigint): {quotient: bigint, remainder: bigint} implemented
divHalfUp and divHalfEven with identical signatures implemented
Calling integer division (/) directly on values typed as Money, Quantity, Price, or Rate is a compile-time or lint error per the ADR decision
Tests covering each mode at positive, negative, and exact-midpoint boundary values
Invariant: quotient * divisor + remainder === dividend for all tested cases
No floating-point literals or Math functions used in implementation
proposals.title: Write ADR-004 and implement bigint division helpers in packages/core
proposals.why_now: Every monetary operation in the domain layer requires division with an explicit rounding mode. ADR-003 prohibits implicit division; ADR-004 mandates it be a compile-time or lint-blocking constraint (the enforcement mechanism is an open DEFINIR). The domain package cannot implement spot order execution, fee calculation, or rounding residue posting without these helpers. Deciding the enforcement mechanism now prevents ad-hoc division from creeping into domain stubs.

proposals.title: Implement domain double-entry ledger in packages/domain
proposals.why_now: The multi-commodity double-entry ledger is explicitly required by FASE-1 acceptance and is the foundation for INV-04 through INV-07. Once nominal types and division helpers land, no remaining DEFINIR blocks the ledger. Every domain operation in FASE-1 — spot buy, spot sell, fee booking, rounding residue — posts through it. Delay here cascades to the tick loop, the CLI replay tool, and the FASE-1 StateHash.

proposals.title: Implement world price generator (two assets, two noise layers) in packages/world
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance explicitly requires 'gerador de preço com duas camadas de ruído e dois ativos'. It is the primary consumer of the positional RNG and the entry point to INV-02 (direct tick query equals sequential advance), which is a gate-CI requirement. Two additional DEFINIR decisions must be resolved as part of this task: octave parameters must be placed in a versioned config file, and the fixed-point or lookup-table strategy for logarithmic price construction must be documented in an ADR (transcendental Math functions are banned in all pure packages per §13 and ADR-003).

repository_assessment.current_state: Monorepo infrastructure, CI pipeline, boundary enforcement, purity lint rules, and the canonical encoder (packages/core, ADR-009) are fully implemented with 101 tests passing. Only one ADR has been filed. Every other package (world, domain, application, narrative, contracts, adapters, ui, apps/desktop) is an empty stub with no production source.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: packages/core lacks nominal types (Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, Tick), bigint division helpers, and positional RNG — the three foundational primitives on which every other FASE-1 package depends before it can begin implementation.

warnings: Three DEFINIR decisions remain unresolved simultaneously: (a) hash function for positional RNG (ADR-002), (b) technical enforcement mechanism for division rounding mode (ADR-004), and (c) fixed-point or lookup-table strategy for logarithmic price construction plus octave parameters (§5.1, ADR-003). Each blocks a distinct FASE-1 delivery chain. Resolving them sequentially rather than in parallel compresses the critical path unnecessarily.

FASE-1 acceptance explicitly requires a minimal installer for Windows and Linux in minimal form ('instalador mínimo existe na FASE-1, em forma mínima. Não no fim', §14.6). No task has addressed this requirement. Deferring it risks discovering platform-specific ABI failures — Electron version pinning, native module rebuilds for better-sqlite3, cross-platform path handling — with insufficient time to correct architectural decisions before the phase gate.
